name: The Shadow Guard
label: Quest
description: The Shadow Guard: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A creation of genius! Much like the Ice Guard, the Shadow Guard employs a thin sheen of protective magic that covers certain pieces of equipment. And like the Ice Guard, the Shadow Guard is going to cost you a good amount of money.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Be gone, insect, lest you have something for me.

clips.title: Completion
paras: What are you still standing around for, traveler? Our business is done.
